# WebAudit Lab

> WebAudit Lab provides focused, evidence-led website diagnostics for technical SEO, web performance, HTML code quality, AI search readiness, structured data and security headers.

WebAudit Lab analyzes public web pages, checks observable signals against web standards, documents limitations and outlines practical next steps. This file is a curated index for AI agents and LLMs; Google Search does not use llms.txt as a ranking or AI-search requirement.

## Tools
- [Technical SEO Audit](https://0audit.com/tools/seo-audit/): Crawl signals, HTTP response, metadata, H1/H2 hierarchy, canonicals, language alternates, links and JSON-LD.
- [Website Performance Audit](https://0audit.com/tools/performance-audit/): Fetch timing, HTML transfer size, potential render blockers and markup budgets. Does not measure field Core Web Vitals.
- [HTML Code Quality Audit](https://0audit.com/tools/code-audit/): HTML structure, document landmarks, image alternatives, duplicate IDs, form labels and inline handlers. Does not execute private backend code.
- [AI Search Readiness Checker](https://0audit.com/tools/ai-search-readiness/): Machine readability, crawlability, extractable answers, entities, dates and references. It cannot guarantee citations or inclusion.
- [Structured Data Checker](https://0audit.com/tools/structured-data-checker/): Schema.org syntax, detected types and visible-content parity. Cannot guarantee rich results.
- [Security Headers Checker](https://0audit.com/tools/security-headers-checker/): HTTPS, HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options, MIME sniffing, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy and COOP/CORP. Not a penetration test.
